strings.en: I am Gu-Landon Gortz.../　Emperor of the Fury.
Celebrate the birth of a new emperor.
Tremble... at your cursed fate and its end.
Perish, Steel Dragons. That is your destiny.
Fools, lament your own weakness.
Burn the Emperor Unit's great power/　into your eyes, and perish.
I shall slaughter you and restore the Fury.
This Zee-Gadin is/　the new guardian deity of the Fury!
We have endured for thousands of years!/　I will not let you stand in the way of my ambition!
The proud pure blood of the Fury!/　I will not let you defile it!
Destruction to those who will not submit!/　The judgment of Voda!
It is you who shall perish here!
I cannot allow your existence!/　For the sake of my clan!
If I am defeated here,/　I could not face those who died/　in the great war of old!
I shall leave not a single one of you alive!
All who defy me shall die!
I will let you go no further!
You have no future!
None may hinder/　my path of conquest!
I will not let my years of waiting come to nothing!
Son of E-Selda, kneel before me.
E-Selda's plan shall be utterly crushed here, today.
Now, the Blade of the Imperial Family shall be mine.
Shana-Mia, you and the Throne Unit shall be mine.
The Throne Unit rightly belongs under my command!
Son of E-Selda!/　I cannot allow your bloodline to exist!
I am the Emperor! Accept me, Shana-Mia!
Woman, I shall slaughter you along with Al-Van.
The crime of leading Al-Van astray/　deserves a thousand deaths.
I cannot allow your existence,/　nor that of Al-Van!
Al-Van... I had high hopes for you.
You are the traitor, Al-Van Ranks.
Al-Van, the Emperor himself shall execute you.
Receive the judgment of Voda,/　Al-Van Ranks!
I have no need of a counterfeit key.../　I shall destroy it all.
Follow your father to the grave.
You who broke Larseilam, perish in despair.
Vaula, perish alongside the Earthlings.
I shall erase you along with your test subject!
Cower. Tremble.
You shall not escape.
You have no way out.
Atone with your death for baring your fangs at me.
Receive my power.
Carve despair into your soul.
Those who thwart my clan's ambition.../　not a single one shall be left alive.
Join the ranks of the dead.
Those who hinder my path of conquest shall perish.
You cannot escape my sight.
Nngh! To think the Zee-Gadin/　would be pushed back this far!
Wh-What? Me... the Emperor Unit...!!
V-Vodaaaa!!
Hmph, you defy me to the last.
Reckless courage will not carry you through.
The longer this drags on, the worse it is for you.
You must have some skill to have come this far.../　but I have far more experience than you.
Hm... The tide has not turned yet.
A direct hit on this Emperor Unit...!
You seem to think that never giving up is a virtue.
If only the Zee-Gadin/　had been completed a little sooner,/　I would never have let you come this far...
Ngh! I will not forgive this! I will not!/　Not such a thing as this!!
Am I being cornered? I?!/　The Emperor Unit?!!
It will not end! My hatred will not end yet!!
Nnngh!/　Who but I can protect the Fury's pure blood!/　Who else can lead our people back to the land?!!
It is not over!/　My war from ages past is not over yet!!
I, Gu-Landon Gortz,/　shall not meet the same end as Vaula!!
Nnngh!/　Let death come! To all who oppose me!!
No matter what power they unleash,/　the Zee-Gadin shall not fall!!
Son of E-Selda, you cannot defeat/　this Emperor Unit with the Throne Unit.
As I thought, you cannot draw out/　the Throne Unit's full power.
What is wrong, Shana-Mia?/　Were you not supposed to have/　the protection of Fureim?
Nnngh, that wretch!/　He has the same power as E-Selda?!
Who would accept that this is/　the will of the god of creation?!!
So, Al-Van, you have improved somewhat.
Curse you, Al-Van! The height of disloyalty!!
To think they could interfere even with the/　Emperor Unit using a counterfeit system...
It is not just the system.../　Do they have power of their own...?
Damn it! I refuse to accept/　that this is the power of the key!!
Should I capture it and study that power source...?
I shall show you that E-Selda's upgrade plan/　was meaningless.
No matter how that prototype is modified,/　it is no match for my Emperor Unit.
Ngh!/　My Emperor Unit, outdone by a prototype?!/　This cannot be!!
Know that you will never defeat me.
Hmph, do you think you have bared your fangs?
How feeble.
You mean to resist with that little power?
What did you come here to do?
Even at full strength, you cannot fell the Emperor Unit.
There is no hope for you.
Lament your own powerlessness.
Hmph, you are no match for E-Selda.
It seems the blood of Shune has thinned.
Bow your head, Shana-Mia. To your new master.
Do not worry./　Al-Van will soon follow you.
A knight's machine is no match for me, Al-Van.
I shall send you to the same place as your father.
A mere fake, after all... Not worth my notice.
I have no need to use Larseilam on you.
Learn the folly of challenging me with a prototype.
You will not hit me.
Hmph, do you call that aiming?
Wretch...
Fuhahaha! Useless!
You fool.
The fool struggles.
It does not reach the Emperor Unit.
Cower before my majesty.
That will not work on this Emperor Unit.
Either way, your fate will not change.
Hmph, a cowardly trick.
There is no escape from the Emperor Unit!
Things will not go as you wish!
There is no escape from your doom...!
Your end is already decided...!
Perish! Before my Emperor Unit!
Receive the light of judgment!
Scatter into nothing!
All who defy me! Fall into the darkness of Voda!!
Woe to my enemies!
Fuhahaha! Carve despair into your souls!
Take this! Orgo-La Viper!
Receive my sword!
Orgo-La Vodo!
Hmmph!
You can no longer move.
Nuooooh!
Deeyah!
Accept your fate.
I shall cleave you in two!!
Taste the dance of the Vodo with your own body!
The ever-changing blade cannot be read!
Hrmm!
Orgone Coating!
Go!
Return!
Haaaaah!!
Cut my enemy to pieces!
Come!
Sever!!
Tremble! Before the Emperor Unit's true form!
Fuhahahaha!!
Busker Mode, activate!
Behold, the Emperor Unit's true form!
Dance, Vodo! As I will it!!
Cut my enemy to shreds!
No matter how you struggle, you cannot escape!
Sunder!!
Savor the sword dance with your own body!
Receive the judgment of Voda!
Condemnation!!
Extractor, maximum!
Orgonite Mirage!
A reenactment of the war of old!
All of you, attack!!
Extractor, maximum output!
Make haste, knight machines!
Strike down my enemy!
I shall slaughter you in Busker Mode!
Orgonite Mirage!!
Be cursed!!
Receive the invitation from the darkness!!
Burn to death in the flames of despair!
Freeze in the darkness of terror!
Sink into the abyss of Vodaaaa!!
Burn to death in crimson flames!!
Freeze in the infinite darkness!!
Despaiiiiiir!!
